papers.title: EgoScale：以大规模第一视角人类数据扩展灵巧操作
papers.titleEn: EgoScale: Scaling Dexterous Manipulation with Diverse Egocentric Human Data
papers.summary: 利用低成本人类视频训练高自由度灵巧操作一直是具身智能核心难题。EgoScale在20854小时带动作标注的第一视角人类视频上预训练流式VLA策略，揭示人类数据规模与验证损失的对数线性缩放定律，且该损失与真机灵巧操作表现高度相关；再经人机对齐中期训练，实现单样本与跨本体迁移。但人手标注质量与极端精密力控仍是落地门槛。
papers.summaryEn: Leveraging human video for high-DoF dexterous manipulation remains difficult at scale. EgoScale pretrains a flow-based VLA policy on 20,854 hours of action-labeled egocentric human video, uncovering a log-linear scaling law between human data scale and validation loss that strongly correlates with real-robot dexterous performance, followed by aligned human-robot mid-training for one-shot and cross-embodiment transfer. Hand-pose label noise and fine force control remain practical hurdles.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；以超2万小时第一视角数据首次清晰验证人到灵巧手的缩放定律与跨本体中期对齐范式。

papers.title: MolmoB0T：大规模程序化仿真实现零样本真机操作
papers.titleEn: MolmoB0T: Large-Scale Simulation Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation
papers.summary: 机器人学习界普遍认为仅靠仿真难以直接零样本迁移到真机。MolmoB0T开源程序化数据生成管线MolmoBot-Engine，在MolmoSpaces中合成170万条覆盖铰接物体操作与抓取放置的专家轨迹，训练的VLA策略在未见任何真机数据或微调的条件下完成静态与移动真机操作。这有力拓展了纯仿真边界，但柔性与高接触力任务仍受物理引擎精度制约。
papers.summaryEn: Robot learning often assumes simulation alone cannot achieve effective zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. MolmoB0T introduces the open-source MolmoBot-Engine procedural pipeline and 1.7M simulated expert trajectories in MolmoSpaces for articulated and pick-and-place manipulation, training VLA policies that transfer zero-shot to static and mobile hardware without real-world fine-tuning. This pushes pure-simulation boundaries, though deformable and high-force contact tasks remain limited by physics fidelity.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；以170万开源程序化仿真轨迹正面挑战“纯仿真不可零样本真机迁移”的共识，是 Sim2Real 关键标杆。

零样本性能高度依赖渲染多样化与专家规划器覆盖度，新技能扩展仍需编写对应任务模板。 / Zero-shot transfer relies on rendering diversity and planner coverage; adding novel skills still needs procedural task templates.

papers.title: RoboNaldo：基于动作引导课程强化学习的人形机器人精准射门
papers.titleEn: RoboNaldo: Accurate, Stable and Powerful Humanoid Soccer Shooting via Motion-Guided Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: 人形机器人高速踢球要求兼具全身平衡、高冲量击球与落点精度：纯动作跟踪难以适配变化的球位，纯任务奖励又极难从零探索出有效动作。RoboNaldo用单条人类踢球参考作为脚手架，通过三阶段课程强化学习逐步把优化重心从动作模仿转向任意球与运动球射门，并成功真机部署。该方法对高动态交互很有启发，但强对抗防撞与多步带球协同仍待拓展。
papers.summaryEn: Humanoid soccer shooting demands whole-body balance, high-impulse contact, and target accuracy: pure motion tracking struggles with varied ball states while task RL struggles to explore valid kicks. RoboNaldo uses a single human kick reference as a scaffold in a three-stage curriculum RL pipeline that progressively shifts toward stationary and moving-ball shooting, deployed on real humanoid hardware. While inspiring for dynamic interaction, multi-step dribbling and opponent contact remain open.
papers.whySelected: CoRL 2026 Oral；以单条人类先验结合三阶段课程 RL 攻克人形高冲量全身击球真机控制，是运动控制精良案例。

papers.titleEn: CAST: Counterfactual Labels Improve Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 10 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 现有VLA模型在相似观测下常忽视细粒度语言指令，根源在于机器人数据集中语言接地多样性不足。CAST将已有轨迹切分为原子决策点，利用视觉语言模型自动生成“若换条路线或目标该怎么说”的反事实语言标注并增强训练，在真实导航与操作任务上显著提升细粒度指令遵循率。该数据增强轻量易复用，但反事实标签本身受限于VLM幻觉与轨迹覆盖面。
papers.summaryEn: Current VLA models often ignore fine-grained instructions under similar observations because robot datasets lack semantic language diversity. CAST segments trajectories into atomic decision points and queries VLMs to synthesize counterfactual language labels describing alternative actions or goals, significantly boosting fine-grained instruction following in real navigation and manipulation. While lightweight and reusable, label fidelity remains bounded by VLM hallucinations and underlying trajectory coverage.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 10 月正式期刊论文；通过反事实 VLM 重标注低成本修复 VLA“只看图不听指令”的顽疾。

prerequisites: 视觉语言动作模型 / VLA models
多模态提示与重标注 / VLM relabeling

limits: 反事实标注质量依赖所用 VLM 的空间与语义理解能力，复杂三维遮挡场景下可能引入错误标签。 / Counterfactual label accuracy depends on the VLM’s spatial understanding and may inject noise in cluttered 3D scenes.
仅能增强已有轨迹覆盖的行为模式，无法凭空合成数据集中从未出现过的物理新技能。 / Augments language grounding over existing trajectories without synthesizing novel physical skills absent from data.
assumptions: 离线机器人轨迹可切分为具语义意义的原子决策段，且 VLM 能据此辨别备选指令差异。 / Assumes trajectories decompose into semantic decision segments distinguishable by a VLM.

papers.title: RADAR：基于检索增强视觉语言模型的机器人泛化数据溯源评测
papers.titleEn: Grounding Robot Generalization in Training Data via Retrieval-Augmented VLMs
papers.venue: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters（RA-L 2026 · Vol. 11 No. 10 · 正式发表）
papers.summary: 机器人论文常宣称策略泛化到“全新场景”，却很少核查测试任务与海量训练数据到底有多接近。RADAR先用通用策略嵌入检索与评测场景最相近的训练样本，再由视觉语言模型对比分析测试与训练间在物体、视角或语言上的真实分布偏移，输出可解释泛化维度报告。该方法为评测把关提供了实用工具，但其结论仍依赖嵌入检索召回与VLM判别准确性。
papers.summaryEn: Robotics papers frequently claim generalization to novel setups without measuring proximity to large training corpora. RADAR retrieves nearest training examples using generalist policy embeddings and prompts VLMs to compare test tasks against retrieved data, producing interpretable analyses of exact generalization axes. It provides a practical auditing lens for robotics evaluation, though conclusions depend on embedding retrieval recall and VLM judgment accuracy.
papers.whySelected: IEEE RA-L 2026 年 10 月正式期刊论文；用检索增强 VLM 量化“测试集相对训练集到底新在哪里”，直击泛化声明失真痛点。

papers.title: SubCure：通过基数修复对观测数据因果结论进行压力测试
papers.titleEn: Stress-Testing Causal Claims via Cardinality Repairs
papers.venue: SIGMOD 2026 / PACMMOD Vol. 4 No. 1（正式发表）
papers.summary: 基于观测数据的因果推断结论往往对少量脏数据或异常子群体极其脆弱。本文提出SubCure框架，将因果稳健性审计形式化为基数修复问题：给定因果查询与目标效应区间，寻找需删除的最小元组集或模式子集以改变平均处理效应，并给出线性回归与逆概率加权的增量ATE更新算法。该方法把数据库修复直接引入因果审计，但聚焦删行型修复且依赖预设因果图假设。
papers.summaryEn: Causal conclusions from observational data can be fragile to minor data errors or small subpopulations. This paper introduces SubCure, framing causal robustness auditing as cardinality repair: given a causal query and target effect range, it finds a minimal set of tuples or patterns whose removal shifts the estimated ATE, backed by incremental ATE updates for linear regression and IPW. It bridges database repair and causal auditing, though it focuses on deletion repairs under fixed causal assumptions.
papers.whySelected: SIGMOD 2026 / PACMMOD 核心工作；把数据库基数修复与增量更新直接用于因果推断稳健性审计，与李的修复与因果主线高度贴合。

sources.label: 正式会议身份 / Formal venue

li.whyRead: 直接把 database cardinality repair 与因果责任审计打通，增量更新推导清晰实用。
li.relation: 连接数据库最小修复、因果解释（causality/responsibility）与查询结果敏感性分析。
prerequisites: 数据库修复基础 / Database repairs
平均处理效应估计 / ATE estimation (OLS/IPW)

limits: 仅考虑删除元组或子群体的子集修复，未涵盖属性值修改或插入类修复操作。 / Considers deletion-based tuple/pattern repairs rather than value-update or insertion repairs.
增量 ATE 更新推导面向线性回归与 IPW 估计器，对非线性或非参数因果估计器尚未给出精确闭式加速。 / Incremental ATE formulas target linear regression and IPW rather than arbitrary nonlinear causal estimators.
assumptions: 观测数据满足标准因果识别前提（如无未观测混杂），且用户提供明确的目标效应阈值。 / Assumes standard causal identifiability (e.g., ignorability) and a user-specified target effect interval.
